description:
Navigate to the 'Photo Hunter' activity in GCompris and complete the first level. 

1. From the main menu, find the 'Puzzles' category (icon of a yellow jigsaw piece) or 'Amusement' category (icon of a ball/clown).
2. Locate the 'Photo Hunter' activity (icon showing a camera or photos).
3. Open the activity. You will see two side-by-side images that look nearly identical.
4. Find the differences between the two images and click on them. Usually there are 7 differences.
5. When you find all differences, a success/congratulations animation will appear.
6. Take a screenshot of this success screen and save it to '/home/ga/photo_hunter_success.png'.
